column2: Act, the Commissioner-General may authorise the following
to  be  done  either  in  writing  or  electronically  through  a
computer system or mobile electronic device:-

(a)
the lodging of an application for registration under

(b)
the filing of a tax return or other document under

(c)
the payment of tax under this Act;

(d)
the paying of a refund under this Act;

(e)
the service of any document by the Commissioner-
General,  with  such  documents  treated  as  being

served  on 
the  date 
they 
are 
transmitted

(f)
the doing of any other act or thing that is required
or permitted to be done under this Act.
